article.intro: A server name has to work in a server list, a Discord and a YouTube title, so short and memorable wins. This **Minecraft server name generator** makes names for SMPs, Realms and servers of every kind, with the right tag on the end.

sections.heading: What makes a good server name
sections.content:
• Short and easy to type: players will search for it, say it on Discord and put it in video titles.
  • Say what it is: a tag like SMP, Factions or Skyblock tells people what to expect before they join.
  • Check it's free: search server lists, Discord and YouTube before you commit, and check the web address if you'll want a website.

sections.heading: The kinds of server
sections.content:
• SMP stands for survival multiplayer: a shared survival world, usually for friends or a community.
  • Realms are Mojang's own paid servers, easiest for a small group of friends. The SMP and survival styles suit them.
  • Factions: teams claim land and raid each other.
  • Skyblock: everyone starts on a tiny island in the sky.
  • Prison: players mine their way up through ranks.
  • Minigames: Bedwars, Skywars and the like, so names that sound like a network.
  • Anarchy: no rules, so names that sound like it.
  • Creative and roleplay: builders and storytellers.

For the teams on it, try the Minecraft Clan Name Generator. For the server's YouTube channel, try the YouTube Channel Name Generator.

faqs.question: What does SMP mean in Minecraft?
faqs.answer: Survival multiplayer: a survival world shared by a group of players, often friends or a creator's community.

faqs.question: What's a good name for an SMP?
faqs.answer: A short, memorable word plus SMP, like Storm SMP or JadeGlen SMP. Choose the SMP style.

faqs.question: What's a good name for a Minecraft Realm?
faqs.answer: Realms are usually for friends, so pick something everyone will recognise. The SMP and survival styles work well.
